Shareholder Gw Henssler & Associates LTD Has Upped Novo (NVO) Position; Karp Capital Management Raised Its Apple (AAPL) Holding by $2.64 Million; Shares Rose
June 17, 2018 - By Vivian Park
Karp Capital Management Corp increased its stake in Apple (AAPL) by 632.85% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Karp Capital Management Corp bought 15,815 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 18,314 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $3.07M, up from 2,499 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Karp Capital Management Corp who had been investing in Apple for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $928.18B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.03% or $1.96 during the last trading session, reaching $188.84. About 33.10 million shares traded or 10.09% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
